Create a new production-quality LEVEL 3 nest sprite candidate by evolving the supplied LEVEL 2 reference. The reference is the exact identity and art style to preserve: charming hand-painted 2D fantasy strategy game object, clean dark teal-brown outlines, soft dimensional painterly shading, rounded readable forms, gentle upper-left light, same front view slightly looking down, no perspective rotation. Keep the characteristic silhouette, materials, colors, central birth area, and recognizable main structure. This level introduces the tribe's first deliberately engineered working mechanism: crafted joints, structural supports, a simple practical device with an understandable purpose, early wood/rope/stone/limited warm bronze technology. It must read as one coherent functioning upgraded nest at small game scale. Preserve the organic nest as the dominant subject and integrate the mechanism into it. Clear substantial forms, restrained detail, refined lovely game art. One single complete nest object only, centered with generous transparent margins, base at approximately 87.5% of the square canvas; truly transparent RGBA background. No ground landscape, no characters, no lettering, no labels, no panel, no UI, no sheet, no cast backdrop, no detached props. This is new source artwork for one level-3 asset, not a presentation board.

TRIBE: sprout bean / living white flower nest. Retain the large ivory curled flower petals, fresh green leaf base and paired seedling leaves, and the warm golden seed visible in the central cradle. Evolve it into a carefully cultivated botanical mechanism: a low smoothly carved wooden support ring nestles within the green leaf base; two visibly jointed curved wooden lever braces run beside the outer flower petals, attached with chunky simple bronze hinge pins and thick green vine cords to a small integrated wooden winch behind one side. The braces visibly help open and close the flower petals. The petals remain soft and open and cradle the seed. The built structure should look ingenious, tender, handmade by tiny plant creatures, with convincing joints and restrained geometric craft details. Maintain the beautiful flower silhouette and an unobstructed central seed cradle. Slightly more developed and substantial than level 2.
